title: RNA Binding Protein-Based Model for Prognostic Prediction of Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Li, Ting; Hui, Wenjia; Halike, Halina; Gao, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文基于RNA结合蛋白构建结直肠癌预后预测模型，属于纯转录组统计与临床预后分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a kind of gastrointestinal tumor with serious high morbidity and mortality. Several reports have implicated the disorder of RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) in plenty of tumors, associating it to tumorigenesis and disease progression. The study is intended to construct novel prognostic biomarkers associated with CRC patients. METHODS: Data of gene expression was acquired from the TCGA database, prognosis-related genes were selected. Besides, we analyzed GO and KEGG pathways. Univariate and multivariate Cox analyses were performed to generate a prognostic-related gene signature, which was evaluated by the Kaplan-Meier (K-M) and the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve. The independent prognostic factor was established by survival analysis. GSE38832 dataset was used to validate the signature. Finally, expression of 8 genes was further confirmed by qRT-PCR in SW480 and SW620 cell lines. RESULTS: We obtained 224 differentially expressed RBPS in total, of which 78 were downregulated and 146 were upregulated. Univariate COX analysis was conducted in the TCGA cohort to select 13 RBPs with P < 0.005, stepwise multivariate COX regression analysis was used to construct an 8-RBP signature (TERT, PPARGC1A, BRCA1, CELF4, TDRD7, LUZP4, PNLDC1, ZC3H12C). Based on the model, systematic analysis illustrated that a high risk score was obviously connected to a poor prognosis. The prognostic value of the risk score was validated in GSE38832 dataset, indicating that the risk model was accurate and effective. The prognostic signature-based risk score was identified as an independent prognostic indicator for CRC. The expression results of qRT-PCR were consistent with the results of differential expression analysis. CONCLUSIONS: The eight-RBP signature can predict the survival of CRC patients and potentially act as CRC prognostic biomarker.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是一种发病率及死亡率均较高的胃肠道肿瘤。多项研究已表明RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）的紊乱与多种肿瘤相关，并将其与肿瘤发生及疾病进展联系起来。本研究旨在构建与CRC患者相关的新型预后生物标志物。方法：从TCGA数据库获取基因表达数据，筛选预后相关基因。此外，我们分析了GO和KEGG通路。采用单变量和多变量Cox分析生成预后相关基因特征，并通过Kaplan-Meier（K-M）曲线和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线进行评估。通过生存分析确定独立预后因素。使用GSE38832数据集验证该特征。最后，通过qRT-PCR在SW480和SW620细胞系中进一步确认8个基因的表达。结果：我们共获得224个差异表达的RBPs，其中78个下调，146个上调。在TCGA队列中进行单变量Cox分析，筛选出P < 0.005的13个RBPs，随后采用逐步多变量Cox回归分析构建8-RBP特征（TERT、PPARGC1A、BRCA1、CELF4、TDRD7、LUZP4、PNLDC1、ZC3H12C）。基于该模型，系统分析表明高风险评分与不良预后显著相关。风险评分的预后价值在GSE38832数据集中得到验证，表明该风险模型准确且有效。基于预后特征的风险评分被确定为CRC的独立预后指标。qRT-PCR的表达结果与差异表达分析结果一致。结论：八-RBP特征可预测CRC患者的生存期，并可能作为CRC的预后生物标志物。
